title: Static Linking and Linker Scripts
description: Follow a link from object files to a finished executable, and write the linker script that decides where every section lands and why.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Read all 10 concepts, reproduce the 116 measured checks in courses/link/assets/samples/crosscheck.py, and run courses/link/assets/samples/linklab.py tour

concepts.title: The Program That Placed Your Binary
concepts.description: ld will print the exact script it is using, and what it does and does not decide.

concepts.title: The Language, in the Order It Runs
concepts.description: OUTPUT_FORMAT, ENTRY, SEARCH_DIR, SECTIONS, and the five operators inside a rule.

concepts.title: Which Rule Wins
concepts.description: First-match-wins, proven in four cells, and the hot/cold partition it exists for.

concepts.title: The Location Counter
concepts.description: The dot, ALIGN, SIZEOF, and one number that moves the whole binary.

concepts.title: MEMORY Is a Budget
concepts.description: Regions, origins, lengths, and turning a silent overlap into a link error.

concepts.title: PHDRS and the -T Surprise
concepts.description: Writing program headers by hand, and the flag that silently changes your output type.

concepts.title: Reachability, and Who the Roots Are
concepts.description: --gc-sections as a graph walk, rooted at ENTRY and KEEP, and why inlining changes the answer.

concepts.title: The Sections the Script Forgot
concepts.description: Orphan placement, and the five sections even the default script guesses at.

concepts.title: What -static Actually Does
concepts.description: 52x the size, one fewer program header, and an e_type the script followed.

concepts.title: Writing One Yourself
concepts.description: Generate a script, place the binary, and verify the result by running it.
